A multi-agentic AI application for IKEA’s IT Operations, integrating RAG and Knowledge-Augmented Generation (KAG) capabilities for intelligent automation and decision support. The system featured agent-based orchestration enabling collaborative problem-solving across IT functions. Additionally, delivered the MCP Scaffolding framework, empowering developers to spin up MCP servers rapidly and standardize application development. Involved in the design and implementation of ODIN platform, microservice architecture, agent registry, tool integration, memory management, and LLM-driven orchestration. Design for multi-agent orchestration, agent lifecycle, tool abstraction, and context-aware query planning with LLM model. Utilized design patterns, best practices, and modern technologies for scalable, maintainable, and high-performing solutions. Collaborated with IKEA stakeholders to align architecture with evolving business needs and GenAI adoption strategies. Hands-on in implementing modules and functionalities, ensuring alignment with the architectural vision.
